description: This file defines a custom NSView subclass (HighlightedMenuItemHostView) and a SwiftUI representable (MenuHostedHighlightedItem) used to create and manage a highlighted menu item view within a macOS application. It handles mouse hover events, updates visual highlights, and manages view layout and sizing.

classes.name: HighlightedMenuItemHostView
classes.description: A custom NSView managing a SwiftUI view with mouse hover highlighting, layout, and intrinsic sizing.

methods.name: init(rootView:width:)
methods.description: Initializes the view with a root SwiftUI view and width.

methods.name: update(rootView:width:)
methods.description: Updates the root view and width, and refreshes highlight state.

methods.name: updateHighlight()
methods.description: Updates the environment to reflect hover state and triggers layout updates.

methods.name: updateSizing()
methods.description: Adjusts frame and intrinsic size based on current content and target width.
